Class AudioDevice

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Audio
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Central manager for all audio operations in the engine, including initialization, playback, spatial audio, bus and playlist management, and resource cleanup. Provides a high-level API for controlling sound effects, music, and audio buses, as well as advanced features like spatialization and sound blocking.
